review_basis: All 277 images reviewed in reports/visuals/all_01.jpg through all_08.jpg. Ranges below are zero-based review_index values from the frozen image manifest, inclusive, showing the same machine in an adjacent capture burst. Distinct decoded machine-sticker payloads separate otherwise very similar planograms; shared payloads merge visits across dates.
unresolved_policy: Quarantine every component without a readable machine QR sticker. Do not treat a new filename, date, or unmatched hash as an independent machine.
limitation: The sticker is a stable photographed identifier, not externally verified machine metadata. The benchmark measures held-out sticker/machine groups within a shared vending-machine domain, not independent stores or Indian shelf generalization.
